connector.name: Drawx MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Generate draw.io diagrams and architecture designs from natural language, via the DrawX API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the saharshpamecha account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DRAWX_API_KEY
env.description: Your DrawX API key (create one at https://getdrawx.com → Settings → API keys; starts with drawx_live_).

env.name: DRAWX_API_BASE
env.description: Override the DrawX API base URL (defaults to https://getdrawx.com/api/v1).
